transcript:
Speaker A: बेटा कहता है मम्मी से इंग्लिश में बात करो, बहू कहती है मम्मी जी फोन उठा लिया करो। पर मैं फोन इसलिए नहीं उठाती क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश नहीं आती। क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश नहीं आती। पोता सोचता है दादी को उससे बात नहीं करनी, सच यह है कि दादी को इंग्लिश नहीं आती। मेरा नाम कमला है, 63 साल की हूँ। बेटा लंदन में रहता है, बहू भी वहाँ है, पोता अर्जुन 8 साल का है। अकेली रहती हूँ लखनऊ में। पोता वीडियो कॉल करता है, इंग्लिश में बात करता है। बोलता है, "Dadi, today I played football, I scored two goals. My teacher said I did very well." मैं बस मुस्कुराती हूँ, "हाँ बेटा, वेरी गुड बेटा।" पर मुझे समझ नहीं आता क्या बोल रहा है। फुटबॉल समझ आई, बाकी सब ऊपर से गया। एक दिन पोते ने पूछा, "Dadi, can you read me a story in English?" मैंने बोला, "बेटा, हिंदी में सुनाऊँ?" बोला, "My friend's grandmothers read in English." मैंने फोन रख दिया। पूरी रात सोई नहीं। पड़ोसी की लड़की ने फोन में 'English Seekho' ऐप दिखाया। बोली, "आंटी जी, ₹1 का ट्रायल है, हिंदी में समझाते हैं, आप भी सीख सकती हैं।" मैंने सोचा, 63 साल की हूँ, अब क्या सीखूँगी? पर पोते का चेहरा दिमाग में आता था, "Can you read me a story in English?" ऐप खोला, जनरल इंग्लिश शो। पहला वीडियो, "हेलो से बात शुरू करें।" 1 लाख से ज्यादा लोग देख चुके थे, प्ले किया। इतना सिंपल था, हिंदी में समझाया था कि मुझे लगा हाँ, यह तो मैं भी कर सकती हूँ। रोज रात को 15 मिनट देखती थी। रोज के 10 इजी सेंटेंसेस, छोटे-छोटे सेंटेंस। "How are you?", "I am fine.", "I miss you.", "Did you eat?", "Good night, beta." यही तो बोलना है ना पोते को? एआई कोच थी, 24 घंटे अवेलेबल। रात को 10:00 बजे जब घर में अकेला होता है, मैं उससे बात करती थी। "I miss my grandson. He lives in London. I want to talk to him in English." गलत बोलती, प्यार से सुधार देती। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली, "इतनी उम्र में क्या सीखोगी?" एक महीने बाद पोते ने कॉल किया। बोला, "Dadi, how are you?" मैंने बोला, "I am fine, beta. How was your school today? Did you play football?" पोता चुप हो गया। फिर बोला, "Dadi, you are speaking in English!" बहू ने फोन लिया, "मम्मी जी, यह कब हुआ?" मैंने बोला, "English Seekho ऐप से सीखा, रोज 15 मिनट।" अब पोता रोज कॉल करता है। पहले हफ्ते में एक बार करता था, अब रोज। क्योंकि अब दादी उसे समझती है, जवाब देती है, स्टोरी भी सुनाती हूँ छोटी-छोटी। "One day, a little boy scored two goals. His dadi was very proud." पोता हँसता है, मैं भी हँसती हूँ। आँखों में आँसू होते हैं, पर खुशी के। English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो। "हेलो से बात शुरू करें" से स्टार्ट करो, एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करो। उम्र कोई बहाना नहीं है, अगर 63 साल की दादी सीख सकती है, तो आप भी सीख सकते हो।
Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Speaker A: Son says talk to mummy in English, daughter-in-law says mummy ji please pick up the phone. But I don't pick up the phone because I don't know English. Because I don't know English. Grandson thinks grandmother doesn't want to talk to him, the truth is grandmother doesn't know English. My name is Kamala, I am 63 years old. My son lives in London, daughter-in-law is also there, grandson Arjun is 8 years old. I live alone in Lucknow. Grandson video calls, talks in English. He says, "Dadi, today I played football, I scored two goals. My teacher said I did very well." I just smile, "Yes beta, very good beta." But I don't understand what he is saying. I understood football, the rest went over my head. One day grandson asked, "Dadi, can you read me a story in English?" I said, "Beta, shall I tell you in Hindi?" He said, "My friend's grandmothers read in English." I hung up the phone. Didn't sleep all night. Neighbor's girl showed 'English Seekho' app on phone. She said, "Aunty ji, there is a ₹1 trial, they explain in Hindi, you can also learn." I thought, I am 63 years old, what will I learn now? But grandson's face kept coming to mind, "Can you read me a story in English?" Opened the app, General English Show. First video, "Start conversation with Hello." More than 1 lakh people had watched, played it. It was so simple, explained in Hindi that I felt yes, I can also do this. Every night I watched for 15 minutes. Daily 10 easy sentences, small sentences. "How are you?", "I am fine.", "I miss you.", "Did you eat?", "Good night, beta." This is what I have to say to my grandson, right? There was an AI coach, available 24 hours. At 10:00 PM when I was alone at home, I used to talk to her. "I miss my grandson. He lives in London. I want to talk to him in English." If I spoke wrong, she corrected me lovingly. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. She never said, "What will you learn at this age?" After a month, grandson called. Said, "Dadi, how are you?" I said, "I am fine, beta. How was your school today? Did you play football?" Grandson went quiet. Then said, "Dadi, you are speaking in English!" Daughter-in-law took the phone, "Mummy ji, when did this happen?" I said, "Learned from English Seekho app, 15 minutes daily." Now grandson calls daily. Earlier he used to call once a week, now daily. Because now grandmother understands him, answers him, and I also tell him small stories. "One day, a little boy scored two goals. His dadi was very proud." Grandson laughs, I also laugh. There are tears in my eyes, but of joy. Download English Seekho app, open General English Show. Start with "Start conversation with Hello", practice with AI coach. Age is no excuse, if a 63-year-old grandmother can learn, then you can also learn.
Speaker B: So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: An elderly Indian grandmother shares her emotional journey of feeling disconnected from her English-speaking grandson in London. She explains how she overcame her hesitation and learned English using the English Seekho app's simple Hindi-based lessons and AI coach. The ad ends with a call to action encouraging viewers of all ages to download the app and start learning.
